# Festival documentation

> Guides and references for Festival, a framework for organizing work with human and AI collaborators using files and Git.

Festival includes Camp for shared workspace context, Fest for planning and tracking goals, and the Festival manager for installing the tools. Obey adds optional agent oversight and orchestration. A camp contains related work; a festival organizes a goal into phases, sequences, and tasks.

## Getting started

- [Quick start](https://docs.fest.build/getting-started/quickstart/): Set up and start using Festival.
- [Installation](https://docs.fest.build/getting-started/installation/): Install the tools.
- [Agent setup](https://docs.fest.build/getting-started/agents/): Set up supported agent integrations.
- [Festival manager](https://docs.fest.build/getting-started/festival-manager/): Manage the suite and plugins.

## Concepts and reference

- [Methodology overview](https://docs.fest.build/methodology/overview/): Learn the planning model.
- [Work items](https://docs.fest.build/methodology/work-items/): Find and organize work.
- [CLI reference](https://docs.fest.build/cli-reference/): Browse command documentation.
- [Obey setup](https://docs.fest.build/obey/getting-started/): Configure optional orchestration.
- [Festival repository](https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/festival): Source, releases, and issues.
- [Festival website](https://fest.build/): Product overview and releases.
